pairs.subject: telemetry-pii-redaction
pairs.evidence: clients/python/lighttrack/client.py:634 The Python SDK serializes and transmits telemetry payloads over HTTP without redaction passes, field inventories, caps, or correlation-preserving pseudonyms.

techniques.evidence: clients/python/lighttrack/client.py:331 Telemetry correlation handles (trace and span IDs) and project attributes are attached verbatim without keyed pseudonymisation.

clients/python/lighttrack/client.py:186 Pattern checking is confined to optional output guardrails on LLM completions rather than executing a two-pass key/value scrubber over outbound telemetry records.
clients/python/lighttrack/client.py:308 Telemetry events are assembled ad-hoc across optional keyword arguments without an enumerated inventory of transport fields and their dispositions.
clients/python/lighttrack/client.py:323 The client forwards copied LLM prompts, completions, and metadata rather than generative composed reports.

clients/python/tests/test_contract.py:97 Contract tests pin the PII table against server fixtures and guard evaluations, but do not assert the absence of planted secrets in serialized telemetry payloads.

declined.subject: telemetry-pii-redaction
declined.reason: Precondition does not hold: telemetry-pii-redaction governs outbound telemetry about to leave team custody to an unowned third-party sink ('if the record is going somewhere you can delete from, that is the neighbour; if it is going somewhere you can only ask, it is here'). pg-event-telemetry is an internal Postgres persistence and reporting store owned and operated by the team, falling squarely under the neighbour subject observability-telemetry. Per instructions, not-applicable is not accepted from this seat, so this context is declined.
